title: Computer Coding Rip Off
text: The Wizard of coding, Apple CoFounder, Steve Wozniak, is getting a bad rap from some of the students who enrolled in his famously portrayed bootcamp, "WOZ U." Enrollees are upset that WOZ U's high dollar coding fees (ROI) return on investment, are not enough, to justify itself. This read is imperative. The details are here: Former Students Say That Apple CoFounder, Steve Wasniak's $13,200 Coding Bootcamp is 'Broken' And Sometimes Links To Wikipedia (AAPL), Business Insider, Kif Leswing, October 1, 2018 .
